subject: English
question_text: What activities did the workers do against the authorities?
guide_solution: They held a rally against the authorities. The rally was addressed by the labour leaders. The labour leaders urged the workers to stand together, to go on with their struggle and not to give in to their bosses.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Sylhet Cadet College, Sylhet (Made Easy Cadet) 2024

question_text: What happened when the policemen attacked the strikers?
guide_solution: When the policemen attacked the strikers, one of them was killed instantly, five or six others were seriously wounded and many others were injured.

subject: English
question_text: Why is the event of May 1, 1886 a reminder for the workers?
guide_solution: The event of May 1, 1886 is a reminder for the workers as it teaches them to stand up and speak out to gain better working conditions, better pay and better lives if they are exploited.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Sylhet Cadet College, Sylhet (Made Easy Cadet) 2024
